args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 mandates banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) to two decimal places. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (`2.665` must round to `2.66`, not `2.67`).

## Change
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Testing
- `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` passes; CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
